before: Compose wrote the room's new relationships after every relationship the owner part held. A checkpoint keeps the room's relationship to a new header or footer in the file and gives a link's back to its suggestion, so after a fold the link's relationship came after the header's, where the live room writes them in key order.
after: Compose writes each new relationship before the first one the owner part holds under a later key the room minted (the key its id gives). Live, after one fold and after two, the relationships parts hold the same order. A file with no relationship the room minted writes as before.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. The checkpoint format and its version do not change: only the place of a relationship in a written relationships part changes. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
